Rho prepares a manually initiated signed native updater for the next reviewed candidate.

## Updates

- Help > Check for Updates now uses a native signed-updater boundary on Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon.
- A separately labelled Install and Restart action is required before any update bytes download, verification, installation, or restart.
- Candidate packaging binds final Authenticode Windows bytes and final notarized/stapled macOS app-archive bytes to separate Tauri signatures.

## Availability

- This source candidate does not assert that a public native-update manifest or installable update exists; exact candidate, installed-app, and release gates remain required.
